title: Inside Hong Kong’s cage homes
summary: A Vox Borders explainer on Hong Kong's housing crisis, the least affordable market in the world, and the tiny cage homes and subdivided flats people squeeze into. It looks at why prices keep climbing and how land policy contributes.
why: Cited in housing and real estate threads as a vivid illustration of extreme scarcity and Hong Kong's land-price dynamics.
